primary.name: X5
primary.description: one-parameter geometric blend of the v6.1 goal rates with the opponent-adjusted xG rating
primary.goals: log mu_side = (1 - w) * log lambda_B0_side + w * log E[xG_side]
primary.w: refitted every 7 days (7-day weeks starting on Tuesday 2026-09-01) by Poisson maximum likelihood on all 2026/27 matches of the 18 xG leagues played before the week, w in [0, 1], one w for home and away

rating_model.form: E[xG_home] = exp(mu + hfa + att_home - dfn_away), E[xG_away] = exp(mu + att_away - dfn_home)
rating_model.fit: per league, refitted for every match day on the matches of that league with xG played on an earlier day (lag 0), Poisson quasi-likelihood

primary.one_x_two: p_k = p_B0,k * P_k(mu) / P_k(lambda_B0), renormalised (P_k = independent-Poisson outcome probability)
primary.markets: production score matrix: reconcile_with_1x2(score_matrix(mu_home, mu_away), p); corners unchanged
primary.baseline: B0 = production v6.1 model set prod_20261012 (unchanged)
primary.fallback: B0 where the league has no xG or fewer than min_league_matches earlier matches with xG

secondary.name: T1
secondary.description: v6.1 XGBoost settings refitted on 2021/22-2025/26 with shot-based xG-proxy features (proxy = a + b * shots + c * shots on target, fitted on August 2026 xG matches)

forward_test.matches: played 2026/27 (and later) matches of the 18 xG leagues with kick-off after frozen_at, every prediction made with data available before kick-off; same matches for X5 and B0
forward_test.planned_power_note: with the in-sample effect and spread, 3000 matches give roughly 60 % one-sided power; the in-sample estimate of the matches needed for 80 % two-sided power is n_required_80pct_power
forward_test.primary_metric: mean per-match Poisson deviance of home + away goals, X5 - B0
adopt_if: primary difference < 0 with one-sided bootstrap p < 0.05 (2000 resamples by match)
Main ROI at real pre-match prices, X5 - B0: lower 95 % bound > -0.02
the over-confidence of the selected Main (stated probability - hit rate) not larger than B0's
forward_test.otherwise: stays B if the point estimate is < 0, else C
forward_test.secondary_rule: T1 is reported with the same metrics (1X2 log loss as its primary) for information; Holm correction over the two forward tests
